lead.event: BEI and KSEI add high-shareholding-concentration stocks to the HSC list and remove them from IHSG
lead.headline: BEI and KSEI list 383 HSC stocks for IHSG exclusion from 13 November
lead.blurb: BEI and KSEI have listed 383 stocks in the High Shareholding Concentration category, including 300 new additions, with exclusion from the IHSG calculation scheduled to begin on 13 November. The classification applies when up to 10 shareholders hold at least 92.5% cumulatively, and the new additions represent 6.16% of IHSG market capitalization. BEI Director Jeffrey Hendrik said methodology changes removed the market-capitalization threshold above Rp5 trillion and the price-impact ratio, allowing stocks to be classified without waiting for price movements.

macro_flows.event: Rupiah falls to a new record low against the US dollar
macro_flows.headline: Rupiah sets reported record low as 5-year yield rises 7.7 bps
macro_flows.blurb: Reports gave rates from Rp18,177 to Rp18,247 per dollar amid concerns over a possible MSCI market-classification downgrade and expectations of higher US rates. Bank Indonesia pledged offshore NDF, domestic DNDF and spot interventions. Doo Financial Futures analyst Lukman Leong projected a range of Rp18,100 to Rp18,200 per dollar.

deals_control.event: Sinar Mas receives conditional approval to acquire Hyundai LNG Shipping
deals_control.headline: Sinar Mas gets conditional approval for 100% buyout of Hyundai LNG Shipping parent
deals_control.blurb: South Korea granted conditional approval on 6 November for Sinar Mas affiliate Frontier Resources to acquire Aegis One, Hyundai LNG Shipping’s parent, from IMM Private Equity and IMM Investment. The equity purchase is valued at about 400 billion won, with the remaining payment and share transfer targeted for 23 November.

deals_control.event: Haji Isam considers acquiring Eramet’s stake in Weda Bay Nickel
deals_control.headline: Haji Isam considers buying Eramet's 38.7% Weda Bay Nickel stake
deals_control.blurb: Through Jhonlin Group, Haji Isam is reportedly considering the acquisition. Eramet might value its stake at up to US$4 billion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BSI lists Phase III 2026 sustainable mudharabah sukuk
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS lists Rp2 trillion Phase III 2026 sustainable mudharabah sukuk
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia's three series carry annual yields of 7%, 7.05% and 7.20%, with quarterly payments and maturities in 2027, 2028 and 2029. The issuance completes the Rp10 trillion continuous offering target, following Rp3 trillion in 2024 and Rp5 trillion in 2025.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: VIVA plans a private placement to convert corporate debt into equity
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: VIVA plans 86.17 billion-share placement to convert corporate debt into equity
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Visi Media plans to issue up to 86.17 billion Series C shares at Rp20 each to creditors Harta Abadi Jaya and Jayakarta Sugih Makmur, converting Rp1.72 trillion of debt without raising fresh funds. The placement is projected to dilute existing shareholders by 83,9590%; shareholders will vote on it on 17 November, with listing planned for 3 December.

market_structure_policy.event: XLSMART wins 700 MHz and 2.6 GHz spectrum allocations
market_structure_policy.headline: EXCL wins 30 MHz of 700 MHz spectrum and 50 MHz at 2.6 GHz
market_structure_policy.blurb: XLSMART bid Rp1,060.2 trillion for the 700 MHz block and Rp231.6 billion for the 2.6 GHz block in Komdigi’s 2026 selection. It plans to expand coverage and 4G and 5G capacity, and must provide mobile broadband in 538 designated villages and reach a 51% 5G coverage target in committed cities and regencies.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI November 2026 index review changes Indonesian constituents
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI removes BRPT and BRMS from Global Standard, seven stocks from Small Cap
market_structure_policy.blurb: BRMS moves to Global Small Cap, while no Indonesian stocks are added to Global Standard. Mirae Asset estimated passive outflows of up to Rp1.2 trillion. Changes are scheduled after the 30 November close and take effect on 1 December.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 4 new articles with a new fact: Mirae Asset estimated passive outflows of up to Rp1.2 trillion.

market_structure_policy.event: BEI revises LQ45 and IDX80 constituents
market_structure_policy.headline: BEI revises LQ45 and IDX80, adding GGRM at 0.41% weight
market_structure_policy.blurb: Erajaya Swasembada and Pakuwon Jati also enter the LQ45, while Central Omega Resources, Impack Pratama Industri, PAM Mineral and RMK Energy join the IDX80. They replace MAPI, NCKL and PGEO in both indices and TKIM in the IDX80 after the stocks entered BEI’s high shareholding concentration list. The changes run from 18 November to 29 January 2027.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: GGRM will have a 0.41% weight in the LQ45.

other.event: Petrosea secures contracts and reports higher backlog
other.headline: PTRO secures contracts worth over Rp15.79 trillion as backlog rises 24%
other.blurb: Petrosea's first-half 2026 backlog reached US$5.36 billion, up from US$4.32 billion in the first half of 2025. Contracts and amendments secured from March to July came from INPEX Masela, Freeport Indonesia, Multi Tambangjaya Utama, and two Singaraja Putra subsidiaries, while mining services accounted for 91.52% of the backlog.

other.event: SMAR announces an interim dividend of Rp 490 per share
other.headline: SMAR announces Rp490 interim dividend per share
other.blurb: Sinar Mas Agro will distribute Rp1.4 trillion in total, a 34.65% payout of Rp4.06 trillion in net profit attributable to parent owners as of 30 September. The cum date is 12 November, with the record date on 16 November and payment on 26 November.

other.event: KEEN signs power purchase agreements with PLN for two hydroelectric plants
other.headline: KEEN signs 30-year power purchase agreements with PLN for two hydro plants
other.blurb: Kencana Energi’s subsidiaries will develop Salu Uro, a 95 MW plant valued at USD 819 million, and Pakkat 2, a 45 MW plant valued at USD 384 million. Pakkat 2 targets commercial operation in Q4 2030, followed by Salu Uro in Q4 2031.

earnings_guidance.event: BBRI reports nine-month profit growth amid share-price gains
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI reports 16.9% nine-month profit growth as shares gain 3.85%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Net profit attributable to owners was Rp47.69 trillion, while credit rose 14.5% year on year to Rp1,647.1 trillion and CASA reached 70%. Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia revised its target price through analyst Kevin Yudha Pratama, citing risks including a 7.6% quarterly fall in net interest income and a 9.97% loan-at-risk ratio.

earnings_guidance.headline: MTEL reports Rp1.55 trillion nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mitratel generated Rp7.01 trillion in revenue for the period, including Rp5.78 trillion from tower leasing, up 2% year over year. Its tenancy ratio rose to 1.60 times across 40,704 towers, while fiber revenue increased 8% to Rp466 billion and EBITDA margin was 82.9%.

earnings_guidance.headline: ITMG reports nine-month revenue of US$1.60 billion, up 16.96%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indo Tambangraya Megah’s gross profit rose 29.2% to US$422.6 million as coal sales volume and average selling price increased. Marubeni contributed US$240.23 million, more than 10% of consolidated revenue, while analysts advised a “wait and see” stance amid commodity-price and regulatory risks.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset downgrades DEWA and cuts its target price
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset downgrades DEWA and cuts target price to Rp280
earnings_guidance.blurb: The valuation change reflects a WACC increase to 16.6% and Gayo exploration assets valued at 70% of book value. Mirae Asset Sekuritas still forecasts Darma Henwa’s net profit rising 37% to Rp897 billion in 2027, supported by increased overburden removal and new Sebuku Sejaka Coal projects.
